title: Relative Abhyankar inequality for a valued field extension
statement: Let $F\subseteq K$ be fields [def-weil-field] such that $K$ is finitely generated as a field over $F$, and let $A$ be a valuation ring of $K$, i.e. a subring $A\subseteq K$ such that for every $a\in K^\times$ at least one of $a,a^{-1}$ lies in $A$ (so $A$ is local with fraction field $K$; write $\mathfrak m_A$ for its maximal ideal and $A^\times$ for its unit group). Put $A_F=A\cap F$; it is a valuation ring of $F$ with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_{A_F}=\mathfrak m_A\cap F$ and unit group $A_F^\times=A^\times\cap F^\times$. Let $\Gamma_K=K^\times/A^\times$ and $\Gamma_F=F^\times/A_F^\times$; the inclusion $F^\times\subseteq K^\times$ induces an injective homomorphism $\Gamma_F\hookrightarrow\Gamma_K$. Let $\kappa_K=A/\mathfrak m_A$ and $\kappa_F=A_F/\mathfrak m_{A_F}$, with the induced field embedding $\kappa_F\hookrightarrow\kappa_K$. For an abelian group $G$ put $\operatorname{rrk}(G)=\dim_{\mathbf Q}(G\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q)$. Then $\operatorname{rrk}(\Gamma_K/\Gamma_F)+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa_F}\kappa_K\le\operatorname{trdeg}_F K$, where $\Gamma_K/\Gamma_F$ is the quotient abelian group.
